title: Autosens / Weighted Average - Sensitivity stuck / not resetting to 100% with COB
symptom: Autosens with Weighted Average plugin remains at 120% and does not reset to 100% when there are carbs on board (COB), even when the user's sensitivity has decreased. This is contrasted with Sensitivity Oref1 which does reset to 100% under COB.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter suggests it is expected behavior: Autosens sticks with the latest calculated value until a new one can be calculated, and while COB>0 no new data is available, so no sensitivity update occurs. However, the issue reporter questions why Oref1 behaves differently, and no conclusive answer is given.
evidence_quote: It always were acting like this - sticking with latest calculated value until new one CAN be calculated. While COB>0 it has no new data, so new calculations cannot be done -> no sensitivity update.
